description: Creates one or more exchange rates for the company. Every rate is created against the supplied `base_currency_iso_code`, which must match the company's existing base currency. Returns 400 if any (base, quote) pair already exists for this company.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Integer ID of the Procore company whose exchange rates are being queried or modified. Obtainable from GET /rest/v1.0/companies.

schema.description: Collection of exchange rates configured at the company level. Each rate quotes how many units of `quote_currency_iso_code` equal one unit of `base_currency_iso_code`.

exchange_rates.description: Array of company-level exchange rates. Empty when no rates have been configured for the company. Only active rates are returned (this V1 GET does not accept an include_inactive query parameter).

id.description: Integer identifier of the exchange rate. Pass this value as `exchange_rates[].id` in the PATCH body to update or activate/deactivate this rate.

company_id.description: Procore company ID that owns this exchange rate. Matches the {company_id} path parameter.

base_currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code of the company's base currency. All rates in this collection share the same base. One unit of this currency equals `exchange_rate` units of `quote_currency_iso_code`.

quote_currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code of the quote currency. `(base_currency_iso_code, quote_currency_iso_code)` uniquely identifies the currency pair this rate covers.

exchange_rate.description: Decimal exchange rate, returned as a string to preserve precision. Number of units of `quote_currency_iso_code` per one unit of `base_currency_iso_code` at the rate's effective date.

is_active.description: Whether this exchange rate is currently active. Active rates are used to convert between the currency pair at runtime. Inactive rates are retained for audit history but not used for new conversions.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking when the exchange rate was last updated.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking when the exchange rate was created.

exchange_rates.description: Array of new exchange rates to create. Each item must specify a unique `quote_currency_iso_code` (the currency pair must not already exist for this company).

quote_currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code of the quote currency (e.g., 'CAD'). Required. Combined with `base_currency_iso_code` it identifies the currency pair this rate covers.

exchange_rate.description: Decimal exchange rate, sent as a string to preserve precision. Number of units of `quote_currency_iso_code` per one unit of `base_currency_iso_code`. Required.
